name: chart-type-chooser
title_zh: 先算清数据能撑起哪句话，再定画什么图
tagline_zh: 别人拿到数据就画图，它先摸清文件底细、算出可支撑的结论，让你在昂贵选项前选对人，而不是画完才发现图不配话。
tagline_en: Others plot first and regret later. This skill profiles your file, computes supportable claims, and lets you.
desc_en: Decide WHICH chart to draw before drawing it. Profiles the data file first, proposes the candidate claims that data can actually support (numbers already computed), lets the user pick one and choose among the expensive options (map or no map, facets or one panel, points or summary), then returns two or three candidate chart types with reasons, the rejected alternatives, the encoding plan, and an a
why_zh: 把「画什么图」从拍脑袋变成数据驱动的决策：先做数值预检，再让用户挑结论和视觉复杂度。
why_en: Turns chart selection into a data-driven decision: numeric pre-check first, then user picks the claim and visual complexity.
limit_zh: 只做图表类型选择，不负责出图。需要数据文件可被脚本读取（CSV/表格）；若数据维度过多或含非结构化文本。
limit_en: Only selects chart type, never renders. Needs script-readable tabular data; stops if data is too wide or unstructured to compute candidate claims.
title_en: Pick the chart after profiling what the data can actually.
